title: 4D-STEM Investigation of Medium-Range Ordering in Bulk Metallic Glasses: Structural Evolution in Shear Bands and Annealing-Induced Relaxation
content: We present a 4D-STEM investigation of bulk metallic glasses (BMGs) to understand how deformation and structural relaxation are associated with the local atomic arrangement at the nanometer scale. 4D-STEM with a nanobeam provides diffraction signals from nanoscale volumes of the material, offering insights into atomic arrangements at the nanometer scale, also known as medium-range ordering (MRO). Using this technique along with analysis methods we recently developed [1-3], we investigate (i) the local MRO structure within the shear band region and (ii) the evolution of MRO structure during structural relaxation induced by in situ and ex situ annealing.
